findings.claim: The publish job cannot go green without publishing, as cargo publish will fail if the old dependency is not on crates.io.
findings.fix: None needed. The workflow correctly checks crates.io and exits with an error on failure, and cargo publish fails on missing dependencies.

findings.claim: Tests correctly pin the shape of the release workflow and can go red on violations.
Moved roadmap paths are no longer read by repo scripts or Makefiles.
findings.fix: Update Makefile, scripts/pre-commit, scripts/install-hooks.sh, and scripts/setup-quality.sh to point to docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml instead of docs/execution/roadmap.md.

findings.claim: CLAUDE.md accurately describes the new roadmap structure.
findings.fix: Correct CLAUDE.md to state that docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml is the active single source of truth, and the archived path is docs/archive/roadmap-execution-frozen-2025-12-09.yaml.

findings.claim: tests/satd_zero.rs correctly identifies SATD markers without hiding real markers.
findings.fix: Remove the `_tests.rs` and `/tests/` path filters which hide markers in test files/modules. Remove the colon from the regex `r"(TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX)"` so it catches markers like `// TODO (REFACTOR phase)`.

findings.claim: Wildcard-free exhaustiveness match is truly wildcard-free.
findings.fix: None needed. Match arms explicitly destructure all 93 variants.

findings.claim: Worker thread panics are caught and treated as failures.
findings.fix: None needed. The channel returns Disconnected on panic, which the test maps to a failure.

findings.claim: The valid_identifier() strategies correctly exclude all reserved keywords.
findings.fix: Add missing lowercase keywords `unsafe`, `true`, and `false` to the KEYWORDS array.

findings.claim: The valid_identifier() strategies only exclude actual lexer keywords.
findings.fix: Remove `is` and `ref` from the KEYWORDS array as they are not defined as tokens in the lexer.
